summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LastMile OS MVP iteration 2 - All backend APIs passing (24/24 tests), frontend features working correctly including global rename, API Documentation page, Settings assignments, and JourneyDetail extended checklist

issues: React warning: indicatorClassName prop not recognized on DOM element - minor console warning, doesn't affect functionality

global_rename.details: All UI text shows 'Ruta/Rutas' instead of 'Jornada/Jornadas' - verified in Dashboard KPIs, sidebar nav, Journeys page title, JourneyDetail page

api_documentation_page.details: API & Reportes page accessible at /api-docs, visible in sidebar for coordinator role, has 3 tabs (Documentación, Sandbox, Ejemplos de Código)

settings_assignments.details: Assignment button (LinkIcon) appears for each user, clicking opens Assignment Dialog with clients/providers checkboxes, user table shows assigned client/provider names (e.g., 'Cubbo', 'Chamedé Logistics')

journey_start_extended_checklist.details: 9 checklist items present (5 original + 4 new: CEDIS arrival, CEDIS pass, Cosmo route confirmation, CEDIS→1st delivery screenshot). Form fields: arrival_time_cedis (time picker), backup_driver_name (text), backup_request_time/backup_arrival_time (time pickers visible only when backup_driver_name has value)

journey_close_return_evidence.details: Conditional 'return evidence' checklist item + image upload section appears when packages_failed > 0 OR packages_to_retry > 0. When both are 0, the item doesn't appear and doesn't block close

backend_start_endpoint.details: POST /api/journeys/{id}/start accepts new fields (arrival_time_cedis, backup_driver_name, backup_request_time, backup_arrival_time) - verified via pytest

db_cleanup_verified.details: Users, clients, providers still exist from seed data. Journeys created during testing are test data

seed_data_creation: Test journeys created during backend testing with prefix 'TEST_' for identification
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are working correctly. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_lastmile_api.py. The app uses 'Ruta' terminology throughout (not 'Jornada'). API Documentation page is at /api-docs. Settings page has dynamic assignment feature working. JourneyDetail has extended 9-item start checklist and conditional return evidence in close tab.
